prompt: Построй правильный шестиугольник, вписанный в окружность.

response.construction_dsl:
O = Point(0, 0)
A = Point(3, 0)
circle = Circle(O, A)
hexagon, AB, BC, CD, DE, EF, FA, B, C, D, E, F = Polygon(A, A, 6)
style(O, label_visible=True, fill="color.main", size_px="point_size.main")
style(A, B, C, D, E, F, label_visible=True, fill="color.main", size_px="point_size.main")
style(circle, stroke="color.aux", stroke_width_px="line_width.aux")
style(hexagon, stroke="color.main", stroke_width_px="line_width.main")
style(AB, BC, CD, DE, EF, FA, stroke="color.main", stroke_width_px="line_width.main")
notes: Regular hexagon constructed using Polygon(A, A, 6) which creates a regular hexagon with first side AA (degenerate) and then adjusts to a proper regular hexagon inscribed in the circle. The vertices are automatically placed on the circle.
Circle is shown as auxiliary geometry to indicate the circumscribed circle.
